applies_to.quote: To All Authorised Dealer Category-I Banks

answer.action: Submit daily data on FCNR (B) deposits, ECBs, and OFCBs mobilized under the swap facility by 6 p.m. every day in the specified formats.
answer.action_quote: All AD Category-I banks are advised to submit daily data on FCNR (B) deposits, External Commercial Borrowings ( ECBs) and Overseas Foreign Currency Borrowings (OFCBs)

comply_by.quote: The data on FCNR (B) deposits , ECBs and OFCBs from June 08, 2026 till issuance of these directions, shall be submitted along with the first reporting due on June 22, 2026.
comply_by.what: Submit data from June 08, 2026 till issuance of these directions along with the first reporting.
